candidates.title: Repeated attestations are counted multiple times toward finality
candidates.summary: Repeated attestations are counted multiple times toward finality. get_attesting_indices() returns indices that are not deduplicated across attestations for a link before summing balance, so duplicate attestations from one valid signer can be replayed until target_balance crosses the finality threshold. Soundness. (core/src/verify.rs, core/src/attestation.rs)
candidates.verdict_rationale: TRUE POSITIVE. Temporary PoC integration test confirmed duplicate attestations from one valid signer can be replayed until target_balance crosses the finality threshold.
